# llms.txt — 欠損駆動思考 / Kesson-Driven Thinking

> This file helps AI assistants and language models understand the structure and content of this site.

## Site Overview

This page is one of the explorations behind the reading "Love駆動開発と呼びたいもの" (https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/reader/love-driven-dev.html). It asks: what do people sense where symbols read zero?

- **Primary Language**: Japanese (日本語)
- **Site URL**: https://uminomae.github.io/project-design-theory/ks/
- **Topics**: Kesson (lack), Holding, imaginary axis, beginnings of vision and design

## Core Concepts

The top page is one continuous reading, in Japanese and English. Each chapter has a short visible part; explanations are folded under "詳しく" (More). All claims are held as tentative views.

### Kesson (欠損)

pjdhiro has described kesson (lack) in several ways (Claude's translations of pjdhiro's Japanese): "If I liken the bodily sense I call Kesson-Driven Thinking to something, it is an intuition that has a value on the imaginary axis, and yet is zero to cognition." / "Among the things recognized on the real axis, something was defined as zero because it read zero, and was treated as meaningless and worthless; and yet it turned out to have meaning on the imaginary axis. I think that kind of thing is a kesson." / "Feeling unease, or feeling that something is missing. Error is one of those." / "I think that wondering 'if those signals well up at the place of zero, what is that?' is the noticing of a kesson." / "A lack may be something that points in a direction: being drawn in, drifting, falling." Each is one face of kesson. A kesson is also something noticed through an error against prediction. When thought and mind drift apart from the signals arising in the body, people may feel that something is missing. pjdhiro sees this as felt passively, without meaning to, because what pjdhiro wants to call Love is driving things.

### Kesson-Driven Thinking (欠損駆動思考)

A way of thinking, a stance of mind, driven by the sense of lack or unease. Holding (below) is one of its workings.

pjdhiro's analogies: "虚軸に値があって、しかも、認知上は 0 の直観" (an intuition with a value on the imaginary axis, yet zero to cognition). A value on an axis at right angles reads zero when measured on the original axis (cos 90° = 0). Or: "質量で歪んだ方向に吸い寄せられるように感じる信号とのギャップ" (the gap with a signal felt as being drawn toward the direction warped by mass). pjdhiro also sees an existential i and meaninglessness as cos 90°: "meaningless on the real axis. And yet."

### Holding (抱持)

Not processing reflexively, but keeping the error as a question. pjdhiro sees a safe place, someone to share the question with, and records to return to as possible footing for it. pjdhiro also sees one's own state of mind as a support, so holding becomes difficult in states like anxiety disorders or at lower developmental stages.

### Where vision and design begin

The lack eventually becomes a problem to solve. pjdhiro sees vision, design, and planning as beginning here; the problem solving after that is what management studies have covered. Kesson-Driven Thinking picks up the lack as a question before that.

## Site Structure

- `index.html` — Main entry point with Three.js immersive visualization
- `connection-stability.html` — A reading (Japanese): what the stability of connection is connected to. Theories of the stability of connection, beyond attachment research, arranged in nine tiers by what they connect to (from the body being touched to an unnamed beyond), and set beside the stability pjdhiro reports feeling beyond metacognition. Only sources whose full text was read are cited. The tiers, the six features, and the reading of overlaps are this page's own arrangement, not the authors'. Tier 4 (the mother as an enveloping environment) cites Ferenczi 1913, Freud 1911 and 1926, and Balint 1937.
- `consciousness.html` — Consciousness-themed experience page
- `src/` — Application source (Three.js, shaders, scene management)
- `src/shaders/` — GLSL shader sources
- `src/consciousness/` — Raymarching SDF consciousness entities

## Technology

- Three.js 0.183.0 (ES Modules, self-hosted vendor/)
- Bootstrap 5.3.3
- GitHub Pages (static deployment)
- No build tools (pure static files)
